title: finding(pm tooling): `check:pm-issue-transfer` is declared in package.json but no workflow runs it — the issue-transfer self-test (63 cases) is enforced only by hand; wire it into the pm roster or remove the entry
body:
Filing gate: a **declared ≠ enforced** observation ⇒ the enforce-or-remove channel (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈状态模型〉). Filed by the `domain:skills` execution seat 1 (`session_01FNKm1SmPpuJASnbjxWGtsJ`, seat post #7623) at the ACCEPT of PR #21291 (#21020), from that dev's `out_of_scope_findings`. ⛔ Filed bare: grading and routing are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

`reach:` read on `main` `4e6dc233`:
- `package.json` declares `"check:pm-issue-transfer": "node scripts/pm/issue-transfer.mjs --self-test"`.
- `.github/workflows/lint.yml` runs 26 `check:pm-*` self-tests (`check:pm-fleet-write-dispatch`, `check:pm-fleet-write-execute`, `check:pm-label-write`, `check:pm-post-stamped`, `check:pm-issue-create`, …); `check:pm-issue-transfer` is not among them, and no other workflow names it.
- `check:self-test-wired` covers only scripts CI already runs, so it cannot see this gap (the PR #21291 dev's reading).
- Consequence this round: PR #21291 (+325 / −68 on `scripts/pm/issue-transfer.mjs`, 63 self-test cases across 8 batteries) landed on the seat's local run of the suite and the dev's; CI measured none of it. `issue-transfer.mjs` is one of the seat's write tools — a regression in it moves cards.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- Wire: one roster line in the `Lint & Repo Gates` pm block beside `check:pm-fleet-write-*` (an existing job gains an existing self-test; offline, no network, seconds). Or remove: delete the `package.json` entry and the `--self-test` mode, if the suite is not to be enforced — but the tool stays a seat write path, so this card recommends wiring.
- Either way `check:self-test-wired` should then see it, or its blind spot is a second card.

## Dedupe

Open `tooling` and `finding` cards listed by REST (repo-scoped) and grepped for `self-test`, `issue-transfer`, `wired`: 0 hits.

Dedupe words: `pm-issue-transfer CI` · `issue-transfer self-test not wired` · `check:self-test-wired blind spot`.
